Every Pastry Is Crafted To Be Noticed. Your Cabinet Should Do The Same.

The display case is not a storage decision. It is a sales decision. And for bakeries, patisseries, and premium food retail, Western Refrigeration just raised the standard for what that decision looks like.

There is a gap that exists in almost every bakery. On one side: the craft. Pastries built with precision — the lamination in the croissant, the set on the mousse, the glaze on the tart. On the other side: the display. A cabinet that cools, technically. That holds the product, technically. But does nothing to communicate the effort behind what sits on its shelves.

That gap is not a small thing. In a category where the buying decision happens at the counter — where a customer either stops and looks or walks past — the display is doing half the selling. Or it should be. The Premium Pastry Cabinet range from Western Refrigeration was built around that exact premise. Two models. One clear purpose: to make the product the hero, every hour the store is open.

“The best bakeries in the world don’t just make great product. They make great product impossible to walk past.”

Evolving the range. Expanding the possibilities.

The Premium Pastry Cabinet is a considered addition to Western’s display range — not a replacement, an expansion. Designed to serve the bakery formats and store concepts that need more than standard refrigeration: the boutique patisserie, the hotel breakfast counter, the premium supermarket bakery section, the artisan concept store that cannot afford to let its display undercut its product.

Two models: the PPTW12HC and the PPTW15HC. Both available in Grey and White. Both built around the same five defining decisions that separate a premium display cabinet from everything else at this counter.

What defines the premium.

Five things. Not five marketing claims — five design decisions that each solve a real problem with how most display cabinets perform.

360° visibility. No blind spots. No hidden product.
Ultra-clear glass on all four sides means every shelf is visible from every angle in the store. Not just the front. Not ‘most’ of the cabinet. All of it, all the time.
More visibility is not an aesthetic preference — it is a sales mechanic. A customer who can see every option from where they are standing is a customer who browses longer, considers more, and converts at a higher rate. The PPTW range eliminates the blind spots that let product go unnoticed.

A monolithic form that elevates whatever it stands next to.
No visible joints. No frames. No interruptions in the body. The Premium Pastry Cabinet is built around a seamless, integrated silhouette — what the product team calls a monolithic form.
In a premium retail environment, the equipment is part of the experience. A cabinet with a clean, unified body does not just display product — it frames it. It tells every customer who sees it that quality is taken seriously at every level of this operation.

Ambient glow lighting. Product-first. Always.
The illumination inside the PPTW range is glare-free by design. Warm LED ambient lighting that draws attention to what is on the shelf — not to the cabinet itself.
Most display cabinets over-illuminate. Harsh light flattens colour, washes out texture, and makes product look clinical rather than crafted. The ambient glow finish in the PPTW range does the opposite: it gives every pastry the kind of light that makes it look like it belongs on a menu photograph.

Uniform temperature. Top shelf to base. Morning to night.
Precision cooling that maintains even temperature across every shelf level, through every hour of operation. Not just adequate cooling — uniform cooling.
This matters more than most cabinet specifications acknowledge. Uneven temperature in a display cabinet means the top shelf runs cold while the base shelf dries out. It means the croissant in the corner loses its texture before noon. The PPTW range was engineered to hold consistent temperature across the full footprint — so the last pastry sold at closing looks as good as the first one placed on the shelf at opening.

Built to scale. Built in India.
Modular scalable design with eco-friendly refrigeration systems. Designed and manufactured in India.
Made in India is not just a provenance note. It means Western’s 26+ service centres are equipped to support this product wherever it is deployed. Spare parts are available domestically. Service response is fast. For a piece of equipment this central to daily operation, that is not a secondary consideration.

Availability & contact.

Both models — PPTW12HC and PPTW15HC — are available now in Grey and White. For specifications, pricing, and dealer enquiries:
